verification_report.summary: Checked all 1 proof items; 1 item(s) failed or were blocked.

critical_errors.location: pi_e1bbb88b0d58f077ad3ef8eb, proof of lem:p213-variation-graph-branch-separation, equations p213-variation-branch-index and p213-variation-residual-slope
critical_errors.issue: The proof identifies the slope with respect to the canonical graph metric with the normalized integer slope -dlog_b|f|. In the cited source, if the map has metric dilation ratio r, the normalized slope is epsilon*r*[s(b):k], so these quantities need not agree. Consequently the asserted integrality, divisibility by e_b, greatest-common-divisor calculation, and primitive-tangent normalization are not justified as written; these assertions are subsequently used in the branch-ratio and principal-divisor arguments.

gaps.location: pi_e1bbb88b0d58f077ad3ef8eb, final paragraphs of the proof of lem:p213-variation-graph-branch-separation
gaps.issue: The deduction of an ambient open tube O_b with O_b intersecting the full tropical image exactly in rho_b is incomplete. Separation of the germs of arms at y by the S-block and properness do not by themselves exclude a subtree attached along the selected arm on which S is constant but a boundary coordinate becomes nonconstant farther inside the subtree. Such a component has tropical image accumulating at a point of rho_b, preventing the asserted open tube. The claim that every attached subtree is either constant for all coordinates or has image separated from the segment is asserted without proof.

gaps.location: pi_e1bbb88b0d58f077ad3ef8eb, proof of prop:p213-normal-curve-arbitrary-valuation-current, assignment of branch coefficients
gaps.issue: The construction of the individual branch coefficients a_b relies on the unproved ambient-tube assertion. Without genuine source isolation, an edge coefficient of the pushed-forward current can combine contributions from multiple source pieces, so the branch functionals L_T and the subsequent Riemann-Roch comparison are not established.

gaps.location: pi_e1bbb88b0d58f077ad3ef8eb, proof of prop:p213-curve-nonsmooth-locus-dichotomy, concluding equivalence involving the normalization
gaps.issue: The dichotomy proved for Y does not by itself establish the statement about the normalized irreducible curve. The proof gives no argument that nonemptiness of the quasi-smooth or rig-smooth locus is preserved in both directions under normalization, nor does it use finiteness and the generic isomorphism of normalization to transfer the loci.

repair_hints: [pi_e1bbb88b0d58f077ad3ef8eb] Distinguish the canonical metric derivative from Ducros's normalized integer branch slope, include the factor [s(b):k], and redo the saturation and pushforward calculations using one consistently defined integral slope vector. Prove a genuine tube-isolation lemma that controls every coordinate on attached subtrees (or add further separating coordinates) before assigning edge mass to a source branch. Then rebuild the branch-ratio argument from that isolation. Finally, add a normalization lemma transferring nonemptiness of the quasi-smooth/rig-smooth locus through the finite generically isomorphic normalization map, or remove the unsupported normalization equivalence.
